d: MITHQAL builds simple, privacy-first financial apps and tools for Morocco.
b: About The mithqal is an old Moroccan unit of weight and currency. We chose the name because our job is to weigh things fairly: a salary, a budget, an expense. MITHQAL is an independent project, built in Tangier by a financial analyst. The apps run on Android with no account and keep your data on your phone. Our calculations follow the laws in force (General Tax Code, finance laws, CNSS, Labour Code). Every rule is dated and sourced, and updated with each new finance law.

b: Analysis · 24 November 2026 2027 finance bill: what every salary gains Under Morocco’s 2027 finance bill, an employee would gain at most MAD 500 net a month, and nothing at all below 5,721.57 MAD gross. We ran the MITHQAL Salary engine on every salary from MAD 3,000 to 50,000. Here is what came out. 5,721.57 MAD Below 5,721.57 MAD gross a month, nothing changes. These salaries already pay no income tax in 2026, including the minimum wage (3,422.72 MAD gross). 8,374.78 MAD From 5,721.57 MAD to 8,374.78 MAD gross, income tax would disappear entirely. At 8,374.78 MAD, the gain reaches 331.27 MAD a month. +500 The gain is capped at MAD 500 a month (6,000 a year), reached from 11,785.10 MAD gross. Someone on 12,000 and a director on 50,000 would gain exactly the same. +5.05% In percentage terms, salaries around 10,080 MAD gross gain most: +5.05% take-home pay. The bill changes two things. It raises the tax-free band from MAD 40,000 to 60,000 a year and shifts the brackets above it. It also replaces the professional-expense rate (35% or 25% depending on salary) with a single 45% rate, keeping the MAD 35,000 annual cap. For higher salaries, professional expenses are already at the MAD 35,000 cap under both scales. Only the gap between the scales remains: from the 34% bracket up, 2027 tax is MAD 6,000 a year lower, MAD 500 a month, whatever the salary. What about dependants? Each dependant already cuts tax by MAD 600 a year. With one dependant, the gross needs to be at least 6,500.01 MAD to see a gain in 2027. And for your salary? Enter your gross and share your result in one tap. Calculate my 2027 gain Where is the bill now? Finance bill no. 60.26 was adopted at first reading by the House of Representatives on 14 November 2026 and is before the House of Councillors. Until it is published in the Official Bulletin, these amounts are estimates. We will update this page and our calculators the day it is published. Method Calculated with the MITHQAL Salary engine (the same as in the app and on this site): CNSS 4.48% capped at MAD 6,000, AMO 2.26%, professional expenses, annual income-tax scale, rounded to the centime. t: Minimum wage 2026 in Morocco: gross, net and history
d: Morocco’s 2026 minimum wage (SMIG): 17.92 MAD an hour since 1 January 2026, or 3,422.72 MAD gross and 3,192.03 MAD net a month. Agricultural minimum (SMAG) 97.44 MAD a day since April 2026. Net pay and 2021–2026 history.
h: From gross to net minimum wage SMIG and SMAG history What else depends on the SMIG FAQ Is the minimum wage subject to income tax? Why 191 hours a month? What will the minimum wage be in 2027? Sources and date checked Also worth calculating Your pay, line by line Other situations
b: Minimum wage 2026 in Morocco: gross, net and history Since 1 January 2026, the minimum wage in industry, trade and services is 17.92 MAD an hour. Here’s what that means on a payslip. 17.92 MAD an hour since 1 January 2026 (SMIG) 3,422.72 MAD gross a month, based on 191 hours 3,192.03 MAD net a month after CNSS and AMO, no income tax 97.44 MAD a day in agriculture since 1 April 2026 (SMAG) From gross to net minimum wage Monthly gross SMIG (17.92 × 191 h) 3,422.72 MAD CNSS (4.48%) − 153.34 MAD AMO (2.26%) − 77.35 MAD Income tax 0.00 MAD Monthly net SMIG 3,192.03 MAD At the minimum wage, taxable income stays below the 40,000 MAD exempt band, so there’s no income tax. The employer also pays 721.84 MAD in employer contributions, a total cost of 4,144.56 MAD a month. SMIG and SMAG history Year Hourly SMIG (MAD) Monthly SMIG (191 h) (MAD) Daily SMAG (MAD) 2021 14.81 2,828.71 76.70 2022 15.55 2,970.05 84.37 2023 16.29 3,111.39 88.58 2025 17.10 3,266.10 93.00 2026 17.92 3,422.72 97.44 In 2022 and 2023, increases took effect in September. In 2025 and 2026, the SMIG rises in January and the SMAG in April. What else depends on the SMIG The tax-free meal allowance is worth 2 × the hourly SMIG, or 35.84 MAD per day worked. Calculate with a meal allowance The CNSS job-loss allowance (IPE) is capped at the SMIG. Calculate the IPE FAQ Is the minimum wage subject to income tax? No. A minimum-wage salary stays below the exempt band (40,000 MAD of taxable income a year). Only CNSS and AMO are deducted. Why 191 hours a month? The legal working time is 2,288 hours a year outside agriculture (44 hours a week). Payslips commonly use 191 hours a month. With 2,288 / 12 = 190.67 hours, the monthly SMIG would be 3,416.75 MAD. What will the minimum wage be in 2027? No decree has set a 2027 SMIG so far. The 2026 amount stays in force until a new decree is published. Sources and date checked Decree no. 2.25.983 (Official Bulletin no. 7469, 29 December 2025): SMIG 17.92 MAD an hour from 1 January 2026, SMAG 97.44 MAD a day from 1 April 2026. Decrees no. 2.19.422, 2.22.606, 2.23.799 and 2.24.1122 for earlier amounts. Labour Code (law 65-99), art. 356 to 361. Checked on 27 November 2026.
